project_info.theme: Teaser puzzle about the missing half of milk coffee
project_info.color_palette: Leaf green, warm orange, cream yellow, white

main_subject.detail: A split-layout teaser poster with large cream-colored text 'Cùng đi tìm Một nửa của cà phê sữa' and a yellow pill that says 'Đón chờ nhé!'. Below are three labeled drink columns: 'CÀ PHÊ CỐC', 'CÀ PHÊ SỮA', and 'CÀ PHÊ ĐEN'. The bottom section asks what object completes the center drink, showing a dotted placeholder box with a question mark. The left answer says 'Phải có GHẾ NHỰA' and the right answer says 'Phải có PHIN'.
main_subject.style: Bold retro-Vietnamese teaser graphic, sharp social puzzle layout, playful brand storytelling
